channel.title: MiaoYan Blog
channel.description: Guides to writing in Markdown and keeping Markdown notes as local files on Mac, iPhone and iPad.

item.title: Mermaid ER diagram syntax: entities, crow's foot and keys
item.description: Write a Mermaid erDiagram in Markdown: read crow's foot markers, set identifying lines, add PK, FK and UK attributes, and fix common errors with a blog schema.

item.title: How to write a README: sections, links and previews
item.description: Write a README.md that GitHub renders well: where it is found, a section order that works, relative links, badges, the outline, and what to preview first.

item.title: Markdown definition list: syntax, support and fallbacks
item.description: Standard Markdown has no definition list. Learn the colon syntax, which tools render it, and the HTML and table fallbacks that work in MiaoYan.

item.title: Daily notes in Markdown: one file per day, plus a script
item.description: Set up a Markdown journal as one YYYY-MM-DD.md file per day, with a small template, a shell script for today's note, wikilinks between days and search.

item.title: Mermaid timeline in Markdown: syntax, sections and examples
item.description: Write a Mermaid timeline in Markdown with periods, several events, sections, line breaks, TD direction and colours, plus when to pick a Gantt chart instead.

item.title: Excel to Markdown table: paste, convert and check
item.description: Turn cells copied from Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets into a Markdown table with a generator, Pandoc or awk, and check merged cells, pipes and line breaks.

item.title: Export Notion and Evernote to Markdown files
item.description: Export Notion as Markdown & CSV and Evernote as ENEX, convert with evernote2md or Yarle, clean file names, images and front matter, then open the folder in MiaoYan.

item.title: Markdown table of contents: manual, [TOC] and generators
item.description: Markdown has no TOC syntax. Write anchor links by hand, use [TOC] where it works, or generate one with doctoc, VS Code or Pandoc, and fix links that do not jump.

item.title: Markdown headings: ATX, setext, levels and anchors
item.description: Write Markdown headings correctly: the # syntax and its required space, setext underlines and the --- trap, heading levels, anchors, and how MiaoYan's outline works.

item.title: Mermaid gantt chart: dateFormat, sections and tasks
item.description: Write a Mermaid gantt chart in Markdown: dateFormat vs axisFormat, task ids and after, excludes weekends, todayMarker, tickInterval and a full release plan.

item.title: Markdown superscript and subscript: what works
item.description: Markdown has no superscript or subscript syntax. Learn when to use sup and sub tags, ^ and ~, Unicode characters or LaTeX math, and what renders in MiaoYan.

item.title: Mermaid sequence diagram: syntax, arrows and a login example
item.description: Write a Mermaid sequence diagram in Markdown: participants, arrow types, activation, notes, loop and alt blocks, autonumber, plus a login flow and fixes.

item.title: Markdown indent: why spaces vanish and what works instead
item.description: Why leading spaces disappear in Markdown, and how to indent with  , a full-width space, text-indent, blockquotes, list content columns, tabs or fences.

item.title: Obsidian vs Notion: local files or cloud workspace
item.description: Compare Obsidian and Notion on where data lives, offline use, sync and prices, collaboration, databases, export and lock-in, then decide which fits.

item.title: Markdown numbered list and bullet points: syntax and rules
item.description: Write a Markdown numbered list or bullet points that render right: start numbers, all-1 lists, marker changes, loose lists, and code inside items.

item.title: Mermaid flowchart syntax: TD, LR, shapes, edges and subgraphs
item.description: Write a Mermaid flowchart in Markdown: pick TD or LR, choose node shapes, label edges, group with subgraphs, and fix the end keyword and quoting errors.

item.title: Choosing a Markdown editor for Mac
item.description: What to check in a Mac Markdown editor: plain files, WYSIWYG or split preview, math, sync and speed, with Typora, Obsidian, iA Writer, Bear, Zettlr, VS Code and MiaoYan compared.

item.title: Markdown cheat sheet: CommonMark, GFM and extensions
item.description: The Markdown syntax you actually use, with examples, what CommonMark and GFM each define, and what MiaoYan renders on top.

item.title: LaTeX math in Markdown: syntax, KaTeX and pitfalls
item.description: Write inline and block math in Markdown, use common LaTeX constructs, avoid dollar and underscore pitfalls, and see how MiaoYan renders KaTeX.

item.title: Mermaid in Markdown: flowchart, sequence, Gantt and timeline examples
item.description: Copy-ready Mermaid examples for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts and timelines in Markdown, plus PlantUML and Markmap, and which ones MiaoYan renders offline.

item.title: Markdown to slides: --- separators and MiaoYan PPT mode
item.description: Turn a Markdown note into a slide deck with --- separators, configure reveal.js options, and compare Marp, reveal.js and Slidev.

item.title: Markdown to PDF on Mac
item.description: Print a MiaoYan note to a fixed A4 PDF, and switch to Pandoc, Typora, VS Code, or the Mac print dialog for paper size and margins.

item.title: Typora alternative for Mac: split preview with MiaoYan
item.description: Why people leave Typora, WYSIWYG versus split preview, what carries over (files, math, images) and where each app is stronger.

item.title: Local-first Markdown notes: keep them as plain files
item.description: Why plain Markdown files in your own folder beat a locked-in notes app, what it costs, and how MiaoYan reads the folder you choose.

item.title: Sync Markdown notes across devices without a sync service
item.description: Use iCloud Drive, Nutstore, Dropbox or git to sync a Markdown notes folder, set MiaoYan's Note Location, and avoid conflict copies.

item.title: Wikilinks: [[note]] links and backlinks in Markdown
item.description: How [[wikilinks]] differ from normal Markdown links, what MiaoYan supports, how backlinks are built, and the portability trade-offs.

item.title: Markdown notes from the terminal with the miao CLI
item.description: Install the miao CLI, learn open, new, search, list and cat, script them, and use them with AI coding agents and the MiaoYan skill.

item.title: A lighter Obsidian alternative for Mac
item.description: What MiaoYan has and leaves out compared with Obsidian, how to open a vault, and which syntax carries over.

item.title: Markdown note version history: MiaoYan, Time Machine, git
item.description: How MiaoYan saves and restores note versions, where they live, their limits, and how Time Machine and git cover what it does not.

item.title: Export Apple Notes as Markdown and open the files
item.description: macOS Tahoe can export a Notes note as Markdown. Sequoia exports PDF only. Check the file, then open it in MiaoYan.

item.title: A Bear alternative for Mac: plain Markdown files
item.description: Export Bear notes to Markdown, move them into folders MiaoYan reads, and see what you lose without tags and gain with plain files.

item.title: Chinese-English spacing in Markdown notes
item.description: Why Chinese writers add a space around Latin text and digits, the exceptions, and how MiaoYan's Clean Typography command applies it without touching code.

item.title: CommonMark vs GFM: which Markdown flavor to write
item.description: What CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown each define, what apps add on top, which layer MiaoYan renders, and a test file to check any editor.

item.title: Markdown code blocks: fences, language tags and nesting
item.description: Write fenced and inline code in Markdown, nest a fence inside a fence, tag languages and diff blocks, and see what MiaoYan's preview highlights.

item.title: Collapsible sections in Markdown and GitHub with details
item.description: Write a collapsible section in Markdown with details and summary, keep Markdown working inside it, and see how MiaoYan previews and exports it.

item.title: Markdown escape characters: backslash, entities and code spans
item.description: Which characters a Markdown backslash escapes, when you need it, entities and code spans as alternatives, and the dollar-sign trap in MiaoYan.

item.title: Markdown footnotes: syntax, support and fallbacks
item.description: Write [^1] footnotes and definitions, see where GitHub, Pandoc and MiaoYan render them, and fix footnotes that show as plain text.

item.title: Markdown front matter: YAML, TOML and MiaoYan
item.description: Write YAML or TOML front matter for Hugo, Jekyll and Astro, see how GitHub shows it, and what MiaoYan hides in preview and export.

item.title: Markdown image syntax: insert, resize and fix paths
item.description: Insert images, set width with HTML, keep paths from breaking, and see how MiaoYan stores, previews and exports images.

item.title: Markdown line break and new line: soft, hard and
item.description:
Why a single newline vanishes in Markdown, how backslash, two spaces and
differ, and what MiaoYan's Line Break setting changes in preview and export.

item.title: Markdown links and anchors: inline, reference, headings
item.description: Inline, reference and autolinks, spaces in URLs, heading anchors on GitHub, and how MiaoYan's preview handles fragments and relative links.

item.title: Markdown on iPad: files, sync and editors
item.description: What an iPad Markdown setup needs, how MiaoYan opens your Mac's iCloud Drive folder, what to check when a note is missing, and other editors.

item.title: Markdown tables: alignment, pipes and line breaks
item.description: Write a Markdown table, align columns, escape pipes, break lines in cells, handle wide tables in MiaoYan, and fall back to HTML for merged cells.

item.title: Markdown checkbox and checklist: - [ ] and - [x]
item.description: Make checkboxes in Markdown with - [ ] and - [x], nest them, see where they render and can be clicked, and find open tasks with ripgrep.

item.title: Markmap: turn a Markdown outline into a mind map
item.description: Turn headings and lists into a mind map with a markmap fence, what MiaoYan renders offline, which options apply, and how it differs from Mermaid.

item.title: PlantUML in Markdown: fences, server rendering and privacy
item.description: Write sequence, class and activity diagrams in a plantuml fence, how MiaoYan renders them with plantuml.com, the privacy cost, and local or Mermaid options.

item.title: What is Markdown? A plain-text way to format
item.description: What Markdown is, where it came from, the ten marks that cover most writing, how it becomes HTML, what it cannot do, and a first note in MiaoYan.

item.title: Markdown horizontal line and divider: ---, *** and ___
item.description: Three ways to write a horizontal rule, the setext heading trap under a text line, raw HTML, and what --- also does in MiaoYan.

item.title: Markdown comments: HTML comments and [//]: # (note)
item.description: Write comments in Markdown with <!-- --> or [//]: #, see where they stay hidden or leak, and how MiaoYan handles them in preview and export.

item.title: Markdown bold, italic and strikethrough, GitHub included
item.description: Write **bold**, *italic* and ~~strikethrough~~ in Markdown, see why emphasis fails next to punctuation or Chinese text, and where GitHub's strikethrough differs from CommonMark.

item.title: Markdown underline, color and center text with HTML
item.description: Markdown has no underline, color, centering or super/subscript syntax. Use HTML, and see what GitHub strips and what MiaoYan's preview renders.

item.title: Markdown blockquotes and nested lists: indent rules
item.description: Write blockquotes, lazy lines, nested quotes and [!NOTE] callouts, learn why nested lists need 2, 3 or 4 spaces, and why 4 spaces can become code.

item.title: How to open a .md file on Mac
item.description: A .md file is plain text. Open it with TextEdit, Quick Look or a Markdown app, set a default app with Get Info, and avoid the rich text trap.

item.title: Markdown to HTML: Pandoc, markdown-it and MiaoYan export
item.description: Convert Markdown to HTML with Pandoc, cmark-gfm or markdown-it, fragment vs full page, raw HTML safety, and what MiaoYan's HTML export includes.

item.title: Markdown to Word: Pandoc, reference.docx and MiaoYan exports
item.description: Convert Markdown to a .docx with Pandoc, set fonts including Chinese through a reference document, and what MiaoYan exports instead.

item.title: Zettelkasten with Markdown files: IDs, links and a weekly routine
item.description: Run a Zettelkasten in plain Markdown files: Luhmann's slip-box, atomic notes, file names, wikilinks, backlinks in MiaoYan, and when Obsidian fits better.
